condition.question: Does the woman visibly have a helmet on her head?
condition.criteria: The edited image shows the woman wearing or otherwise visibly having a helmet on her head.
condition.binding: Compare the woman in SOURCE with the woman in EDITED; assess whether EDITED adds the requested helmet.
condition.endpoint: A helmet is visibly on the woman’s head.
condition.necessity: This is the requested change: giving the woman a helmet.
condition.zero_when: The woman has no helmet on her head in EDITED; unrelated edits do not count.
condition.half_when: A helmet is partly added or only partly on her head, with concrete visible deficiencies preventing the requested endpoint.
condition.full_when: The woman visibly wears or otherwise has a helmet on her head in EDITED.
